author: Phobiaxx
body:
Purpose: To create a better In-Game Community, and promote the server.
What it is: Several types of console messages, Voting, Forums, Rules, Event, and Report.
Hub Messages:
When a player first joins the server, they get spammed with 6 bold/colored messages saying "Follow the rules! Read them at www.avicus.net/rules!"
Every time they rejoin, they get 1 message ^.

Every 24 hours, you get 1 bold/colored message saying "Vote at www.avicus.net/vote for Free XP!"

Sr. Mods+ can /hmsg event <message>
The message will show up once every time someone joins the hub.

Every 2 days you get one message in the hub saying, "Join the forums! www.avicus.net/forums!"
Server Messages:

Every 30 minutes or so, "See anyone misbehaving? Don't say anything about it in chat! Just /report!(Especially for hackers!)"

Of course, this would become a nuisance to people who know.
Every other message it'll send another message saying "Annoyed with these messages? /hmsg toggle off to turn them off! /hmsg vote off to toggle vote messages off!"
Event messages can't be toggled, or voting, voting needs the separate /hmsg vote off to toggle.

So, what do you think? :P
Comment below, or take a survey! https://tridentspqr.typeform.com/to/J9OmgK ^-^

replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body:
I like it.  Got my vote.

However, I made a thread about this before: mods need to be able to hide their IGN.  Players can type /who to see who is spectating and playing.  If they see a mod on and they know they are breaking a rule, they can leave without the mod having any proof to punish the player.  I know this would take a long time to code, but I think it would be worth it.  Also, there is a new coding team who are looking for projects.  Maybe this would be a great test to see what they could do.
